descriptionInUI: Draws every country's real border on the F10 map. A country with no coalition airfield inside it stands live SAM batteries inside its own territory from mission start -- what it fields comes off how much room it has, from an SA-3 up to an S-300 or Patriot, and so does how many, spread along the stretch of frontier the war is near and each placed deep enough that its envelope just covers the border. They sit there as true neutrals and cannot fire, because a neutral unit in DCS never can. Enter and you are warned by radio at once; stay past the engage timer or release a weapon inside the border, and the whole country changes sides and engages. AI intruders are never engaged. Batteries are free, untracked event content.
